Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a work group to assess prior learning at institutions of higher education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assessment of prior learning at institutions ofhigher education; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that adultlearners entering workforce and academic programs will comprise agrowing percentage of higher education enrollments in coming years. Itis strategically important, for a vital economy and globalcompetitiveness, to ensure that adult learners move throughpostsecondary education in the most efficient manner possible and enterthe workforce wellprepared. (2) The legislature also finds that Washington must make an effortto more effectively use resources at the state's public twoyear andfouryear institutions of higher education to facilitate wider anddeeper adult participation in postsecondary education. (3) The legislature also finds that adult learners encounterbarriers in pursuit of their postsecondary education. Institutionalpolicies and procedures regarding the acceptance of prior learningcredits are not aligned with accreditation rules and national bestpractices. p. 1 SHB 2933 (4) Therefore, it is the legislature's intent to create pathwaysfor adult learners to gain credit for learning from a variety ofsources so that college level learning acquired before enrollment canbe applied toward academic and workforce degrees.

(1) The higher education coordinating boardshall convene a work group that includes representatives from the stateboard for community and technical colleges, the workforce training andeducation coordinating board, the council of presidents, the office ofthe superintendent of public instruction, as well as the twoyear andfouryear institutions of higher education to examine policies relatedto the acceptance of prior learning credits at institutions of highereducation. The work group shall make policy recommendations in thefollowing two areas related to prior learning assessment, givingspecial consideration to recommendations made by the council for adultand experiential learning and accreditation rules adopted by thenorthwest commission on colleges and universities: (a) The proportion of twoyear and fouryear academic and workforcedegrees that can be comprised of credits granted through the assessmentof prior learning; and (b) The applicability of prior learning credits toward generaleducation requirements and majorspecific requirements. (2) The study shall also include recommendations on implementationof the work group's recommendations at public twoyear and fouryearinstitutions of higher education. (3) The work group shall report to the appropriate committees ofthe legislature by December 1, 2008.
If specific funding for the purposes of thisact, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, is not provided byJune 30, 2008, in the omnibus appropriations act, this act is null andvoid.
